design_basis.name: PageIndex
design_basis.adapted_mechanism: 长文档节点树、稳定节点关系和按章节祖先导航

design_basis.name: RAGFlow
design_basis.adapted_mechanism: 父子分块保留结构元数据，并让分块和来源可检查

design_basis.name: SoulDrive roadmap
design_basis.adapted_mechanism: S5 长论文/标准层级文档树路由和证据可追溯

contract.node_id: sha256(document_id + NUL + normalized_full_section_path) first 20 hex characters
contract.summary: deterministic extractive first sentence, capped at 240 characters
route: exact node title or full path reference
descendant chunk match through persisted ancestor IDs
legacy section_path route when tree metadata is absent
stores: encrypted child and parent metadata through the existing secure store
contract.scope: tree metadata is routing and provenance metadata; dense, sparse, graph, reranker, evidence gate and project/global filters remain unchanged

interpretation: The increment proves deterministic tree construction, stable parent/child/ancestor metadata, full-path routing, ordinary-index metadata preservation, and encrypted-index round-trip visibility without breaking the backend regression suite. It does not prove a retrieval or answer-accuracy gain.
limitations: The existing encrypted production workspace was not rebuilt or overwritten; its keys and data remain untouched.
The previously isolated six-PDF retrieval index was built before this persistence increment and was not silently replaced, so its 16-sample metrics remain section_path/no-regression evidence only.
The implementation uses a deterministic extractive summary rather than a model-generated PageIndex summary; no extra model call is introduced.
A long-paper/standard end-to-end retrieval and answer comparison, sealed-test evaluation, and multi-document citation audit are still required.
No sealed-test data, metric definition, retrieval weight, model, or production privacy boundary was changed.
